# Before UI fixture

The two templates in this directory are copied byte-for-byte from commit
74987b884d2dd4845ee6030f87838a36951f05f5. The browser contract renders that UI and
the changed templates at 1920×940 and 390×844, using the repository's existing
lamp image. API transport and database persistence are local test doubles.
Screenshots prove the review UI, not production OCR, CDN publication or product
cleaning success. Output: artifacts/hrep2-review/{width}-{before,after}.png.
